newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks end firm in a technical rally.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks end firm in a technical rally.

text.p: Chilean shares closed stronger for the second day in a row in a technical rebound following recent heavy losses, said traders.
The bolsa is expected to continue to rally next week, although volume will be light due to Christmas, said Guillermo Tagle, head of research at Santander Investment.
"The atmosphere is a little better. The fall this week has made investors look at the market with new interest," he said.
The selective IPSA index closed up 0.36 percent at 88.66 points. The general IGPA index gained 0.22 percent to 4,893.33 points.
Turnover was a moderate 13.9 billion pesos.
The market was cheered by Chilean electricity firms' success in Colombia's power sell-off with Endesa buying the Betania plant and Chilgener winning the Chivor power station, said traders.
But despite the good news, power shares closed mixed with Endesa continuing to be hurt by fears of the impact of this year's drought on the company's earnings, they said.
Endesa rose 0.23 percent to 214 pesos, while its parent company Enersis shed 0.44 percent to 223-3/4 pesos.
